scope: All eight closed P45 cells, every saved program and every format rejection. Selected after manual inspection of P45 outcomes, not a blind or confirmatory experiment.
rule: Attach an exact already-exposed public contract or its parameter-name control only to a confirmed undispatched unknown-parameter rejection. Do not disclose unexposed APIs, echo argument values, rename arguments, execute a repair, or change earlier effects. Bound the feedback, falling back to names or the original rejection.
interpretation: Existing detailed validation feedback is a strong ordinary control. Availability, character size and observed follow-up lookup do not establish token savings, task quality or novelty. Prospective generation conditions must be fixed separately.
